rv.q: Slanted Floors is both a plea for, and a fascinating example of, creativity and human connection unmediated by the tyranny of the screen.
Billy McEntee’s intimate two-hander Slanted Floors finds high stakes in the smallest domestic rituals, and Kyle Beltran and Adam Chanler-Berat play them with unnerving, lived-in precision.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive two-hander for its voyeuristic intimacy and authentic atmosphere, drawing audiences into a meticulously detailed NYC apartment where a gay couple navigates creative struggles with uncanny depth.

vr.q: it is certainly a very unique experience with or without soup
